description: Périmètre de protection immédiat (PPI) des captages d'eau de Bourgogne-Franche-Comté is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Regional geographical layer obtained by compiling the data produced by the departmental antennas. Rightholders have several ways to download: Download by the thematic map capture Download by the description sheet, pressing the greenest in the top right, click on add to cart (then a popup window will invite you to click on download). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Immediate protection perimeter (IPP) of the water catchments of Burgundy-Franche-Comté" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include AEP, Alimentation en eau potable. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
